interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email?: string;
}
type Keys = keyof User;
const k: Keys = "name";
type NameType = User["name"];
const nm: NameType = "Bob";
type PartialUser = Partial<User>;
const pu: PartialUser = {};
type RequiredUser = Required<User>;
const ru: RequiredUser = { id: 1, name: "a", email: "e" };
type ReadonlyUser = Readonly<User>;
const rdu: ReadonlyUser = { id: 2, name: "b" };
type Preview = Pick<User, "id" | "name">;
const pv: Preview = { id: 3, name: "c" };
type NoEmail = Omit<User, "email">;
const ne: NoEmail = { id: 4, name: "d" };
type Scores = Record<"math" | "art", number>;
const sc: Scores = { math: 1, art: 2 };
type T1 = Exclude<"a" | "b" | "c", "a">;
const t1: T1 = "b";
type T2 = Extract<string | number | boolean, number | boolean>;
const t2: T2 = true;
type T3 = NonNullable<string | null | undefined>;
const t3: T3 = "nn";
function makeUser(id: number, name: string) {
  return { id, name };
}
type R = ReturnType<typeof makeUser>;
const r: R = { id: 5, name: "e" };
type P = Parameters<typeof makeUser>;
const p: P = [6, "f"];
type IsString<T> = T extends string ? "yes" : "no";
const y1: IsString<"x"> = "yes";
const y2: IsString<1> = "no";
type ElementOf<T> = T extends (infer U)[] ? U : never;
const e: ElementOf<number[]> = 3;
type Getters<T> = { [K in keyof T as `get${Capitalize<string & K>}`]: () => T[K] };
const gs: Getters<{ age: number }> = { getAge: () => 7 };
type Upper = Uppercase<"abc">;
const up: Upper = "ABC";
type EventName = `on${"Click" | "Hover"}`;
const ev: EventName = "onHover";
type Mutable<T> = { -readonly [K in keyof T]: T[K] };
const mu: Mutable<ReadonlyUser> = { id: 1, name: "m" };
mu.id = 9;
const config = { mode: "dark", size: 3 } as const;
type Mode = typeof config.mode;
const md: Mode = "dark";
type Arr = typeof ["a", "b"];
const tup = ["a", "b"] as const;
type First = (typeof tup)[0];
const fi: First = "a";
type Num = (typeof tup)[number];
const nu: Num = "b";
type Id = `id-${number}`;
const id: Id = "id-42";
console.log(k, nm, pu, ru, rdu, pv, ne, sc, t1, t2, t3, r, p, y1, y2, e, gs.getAge(), up, ev, mu, md, fi, nu, id);
